name: @workerv2/image-processors
description: Worker V2 Image Foundation Processors — the first concrete processors, built with the Processor SDK, that perform GENERIC image normalization and metadata extraction while staying independent of album rendering. Six single-transformation processors (validate, decode, metadata, EXIF-orientation, color-profile-normalize, format-normalize) that consume and produce immutable, content-addressed Artifacts, deterministically and cross-platform. Pure TypeScript container parsing — NO native codec. Implements NO album knowledge, NO page composition, NO PDF, NO layout, and assumes NO storage/R2 implementation.
